policy: No game/car screenshot sent and no vehicle released as approved without human inspection of real Blender GLB front/side/three-quarter views, door-open/shut comparison and Godot kinematics.
reference_direction: 2026 premium stylized modern auto design with recognizable body class and credible manufacturer-era proportions; original brands and no copied logos

reasons: Body too long and generic vs low modern V12 hypercar
Flat roof panel and simple black-hole grille
Body looks like a raised rectangular mockup
Hood and rear proportions do not match modern compact sedan
Pickup cab and bed require real modern truck sculpting
Door/quarter panel needs physically sensible gaps
Lights and bumper lack current truck design detail
Angular side silhouette and front/rear clip not close enough to target category
Needs distinct geometric tailgate and proper cabin glazing
